|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 6) of the Virtual Modern card (the PC errata-sheet slip). It is not the current version; the current version is [[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka (Errata 5)]] (PC-E5). The image is the Players Committee errata-sheet slip of this version ([[:File:V8-D-Lieutenant_Dopheld_Mitaka-errata-sheet-2022-06-29.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V8-D-Lieutenant_Dopheld_Mitaka-errata-sheet-2022-06-29-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V8-D-Lieutenant_Dopheld_Mitaka-original-2018-07-08-022435b.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V8-D-Lieutenant_Dopheld_Mitaka-errata-sheet-2022-06-29-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V8-D-Lieutenant_Dopheld_Mitaka-errata-sheet-2022-06-29.png]], 29 June 2022).
* '''Original''' ([[Lieutenant Dopheld Mitaka]]): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-lieutenantdopheldmit022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/lieutenantdopheldmitaka.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual8-Dark/large/lieutenantdopheldmitaka.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Lieutenant Tanbris”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When drawn for destiny, use 1 Force or this card is lost. During your deploy phase, may use 3 Force to relocate Kylo from here to same site as a Resistance character.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Errata-sheet slip, Errata Sheet July 2022<ref name="sheet-2022-06-29">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-072022.pdf Errata Sheet July 2022] (Players Committee), page 1; PDF built 29 June 2022. Listed on the PC's [https://web.archive.org/web/20240920164229/https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips page] (Internet Archive, 20 September 2024).</ref> — the cut-out slip the PC published for sleeving over the card (an errata-sheet slip is its own version, separate from the PC card image of the same errata; Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''What changed:''' “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When drawn” → “When drawn”; “is lost. During your” → “is lost. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your”; “a Resistance character.” → “a Resistance Agent.”; the errata mark “E1” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none); this version is the errata-sheet slip (a different printing from the card image before it). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Lieutenant Tanbris”. Text: “When drawn for destiny, use 1 Force or this card is lost. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. During your deploy phase, may use 3 Force to relocate Kylo from here to same site as a Resistance Agent.”
